# DSI Direct

> DSI Direct provides comprehensive healthcare storage solutions and inventory management systems designed to optimize medical facility operations, from sterile processing departments to operating rooms.

Distribution Systems International (DSI) specializes in high-density storage systems, medical carts, and workflow optimization for hospitals and healthcare facilities. The company offers both products and consulting services to streamline healthcare supply chain management and operational efficiency.

## Key Topics

- Healthcare Storage Solutions
- High-Density Storage
- Sterile Processing (SPD)
- Operating Room (OR) Storage
- Medical Inventory Management
- MODU-MAX Systems
- LEAN/KANBAN Methods
- Surgical Case Carts
- Medical Carts
- Supply Chain Optimization
- Stainless Steel Cabinets
- Workflow Assessment
- 2-Bin Kanban System
- No-Tear Storage System
- Materials Management

## Core Products & Solutions

- [Products](https://www.dsidirect.com/products): Main product catalog for DSI's medical inventory management solutions
- [High-Density Storage Solutions](https://www.dsidirect.com/high-density-supply-storage): MODU-MAX high-density storage system for healthcare facilities
- [Sterile Storage Solutions](https://www.dsidirect.com/sterile-instrument-storage): MODU-MAX CTS sterile storage for SPD and OR compliance
- [Medical Supply Storage](https://www.dsidirect.com/medical-supply-storage): MODU-CELL medical supply storage for OR and healthcare facilities
- [Stainless Steel Medical Cabinets](https://www.dsidirect.com/or-cabinets): MODU-CAB stainless steel cabinets for OR and surgical storage
- [Medical Wire Shelving Solutions](https://www.dsidirect.com/medical-wire-shelvings): Chrome wire shelving and Modu-Wall solutions for healthcare storage
- [Medical Storage Bins](https://www.dsidirect.com/medical-storage-bins): Stackable polypropylene bins for medical supply organization
- [Mobile Storage Track Systems](https://www.dsidirect.com/mobile-storage-track-systems): High-density track systems for SPD, OR, and materials management

## Medical Carts & Mobile Equipment

- [Medical Carts & Crash Carts](https://www.dsidirect.com/medical-carts): Crash carts, anesthesia, and emergency carts for healthcare facilities
- [Surgical Case Carts](https://www.dsidirect.com/surgical-case-carts): Triton case carts and NO-TEAR storage for CS/SPD sterilization
- [Ergonomic Hospital Workstations](https://www.dsidirect.com/workstations): Ergonomic hospital workstations and accessories for staff efficiency

## Inventory Management & Workflow Systems

- [LEAN Inventory Management Process](https://www.dsidirect.com/process): LEAN inventory management and 2-Bin Kanban system implementation
- [2-Bin Kanban System](https://www.dsidirect.com/2-bin-kanban-system): 2-Bin Kanban and LEAN inventory management system guide
- [No-Tear Storage System](https://www.dsidirect.com/no-tear-storage-system): No-Tear system specifications for surgical instrument handling
